description:
Dry-run an Ethereum transaction without broadcasting it to the network (mainnet or sepolia only — this endpoint does not support other EVM chains). Returns estimated gas usage, execution success/failure, and any revert reason. Use this to validate transactions before signing and broadcasting — helpful for catching errors, estimating costs, and debugging contract interactions.

Credits per call: 48

Credits are indicative only and may change at any time. The actual credits spent for each API request are returned in the response headers.

context.description: Optional context for the request - echoed back in response

data.description: Hex-encoded calldata for contract interaction or deployment bytecode

gasLimit.description: Custom gas limit override (auto-estimated if omitted)

gasPrice.description: Custom gas price in wei (auto-estimated if omitted)

network.description: Network name (Ethereum only — mainnet or sepolia)

toAddress.description: Recipient or contract address (omit for contract deployment simulation)

value.description: Amount in native coin's smallest unit, e.g. wei (defaults to '0')

name: simulate__simulate_evm
